correctness.rationale: A facet is precisely the complement of an inclusion-minimal transversal of the 14 given monomial supports on 30 vertices. Independent enumeration used an unrestricted minimal-transversal recursion, so it could detect larger minimal covers; it agreed with the separate exhaustive check of all 27,405 four-subsets and returned 130 covers, all of size four. The frozen JSON contains each exactly once. For every earlier/current facet pair the independent checker found an earlier facet whose intersection with the current facet is a ridge containing the given pair intersection (8,385 pairs). This makes the intersection with the preceding union pure of codimension one at each step. Pure shellability gives Cohen–Macaulayness over any field. This proves the finite case only.
